name: (Risen Nemesis) Pained Retribution
text: The Risen Nemesis demands the PCs see how they have wronged them. All PCs within 30 feet of the Risen Nemesis must attempt a DC 42 Will save save. Regardless of the outcome, the PCs become temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours. On failure, the PCs are Restrained by invisible chains of guilt that only they can see (escape dc=42). On a critical failure, the PC is also Slowed 1 for 1 minute as they hesitate from a guilty conscience.
